g.text: Data model: users, roles and notifications

text.tspan: users.role: customer (one clients row, CNPJ), staff and manager (one employees row with a sector), admin (employees row, no sector).
The JWT subject is users.email; deleting a user cascades to its clients or employees row.
Outside this diagram: notifications.request_id → credit_requests.id; credit_requests.client_id → clients.id (data-model).
